content.text: Let me look at how the QR gets rendered and try a direct call to the login flow.
The QR fetch is a simple HTTPS POST to `ilinkai.weixin.qq.com`. I can call it directly and get the URL the user can scan.
I have everything I need. Let me grab the ILINK_APP_ID and call the API directly.

  -H "iLink-App-Id: bot" \
  -H "iLink-App-ClientVersion: 2" \
  -H "X-WECHAT-UIN: $(echo $RANDOM | base64)" \
  -d '{"local_token_list": []}' \
  --max-time 15 2>&1 | head -50
